gallery.description: Aerial view of Laurel River Dam and Lake on the Laurel River above the confluence with the Cumberland River near Corbin, Kentucky, USA. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers completed the dam and the lake impounded in 1974. The dam is 282 feet (86 m) high and 1,420 feet (433 m) long. The hydroelectric plant in the dam produces 74 MW of electric power.
